[[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] '''royal guards'''<ref name="Old EG" /> were [[Warrior caste (Geonosian)/Legends|warrior caste]] Geonosians<ref name="Legacy" /> tasked with serving as [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguards]].<ref name="Old EG" /> Two guarded [[Archduke/Legends|Archduke]] [[Poggle the Lesser/Legends|Poggle the Lesser]] during the later phases of the [[Second Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Second Battle of Geonosis]].<ref name="Legacy" />
